Plan: 1 to add, 1 to modify.

Summary by type:
  types: 1 to modify
  functions: 1 to add

Types:
  ~ span

Functions:
  + int_diff

DDL to be executed:
--------------------------------------------------

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION int_diff(
    x integer,
    y integer
)
RETURNS double precision
LANGUAGE sql
IMMUTABLE
STRICT
AS $$SELECT (x - y)::double precision
$$;

DROP TYPE IF EXISTS span RESTRICT;

CREATE TYPE span AS RANGE (
    subtype = integer,
    subtype_diff = int_diff
);
